make.name: Subaru
make.description: Japanese carmaker known for all-wheel drive and boxer engines. After a small run of the Plug-in Stella kei EV in 2009, its battery-electric cars have all been co-developed with Toyota: the Solterra (2022), and for 2026 the Trailseeker and Uncharted, with the three-row Getaway to follow.

models.name: Plug-in Stella
models.description: Electric version of the Stella kei car, shown in 2008 and delivered to Japanese fleet and government buyers from July 2009, with about 170 units planned through March 2010. A planned European launch did not happen.

generations.name: Plug-in Stella
generations.description: Lithium-ion kei-class EV developed from the R1e prototype programme.

sources.name: Fuji Heavy Industries press release (27 Jun 2008, archived)

models.name: Solterra
models.description: Subaru's version of the Toyota bZ4X, built by Toyota on the e-TNGA platform and sold since mid-2022 in Japan, the US, Canada, Europe and China. US cars are all-wheel drive. A 2026 model-year facelift brought a 74.7 kWh pack, 233 or 338 hp, up to 288 miles EPA and a NACS port.

models.name: Trailseeker
models.description: Subaru's version of the long-wheelbase Toyota bZ Woodland / bZ4X Touring, announced in April 2025; sold as the E-Outback in Europe, Singapore and Taiwan. In the US it is all-wheel drive with 375 hp.

generations.description: 74.7 kWh pack, 375 hp dual-motor AWD in the US, NACS port, 150 kW DC charging.

models.name: Uncharted
models.description: Subaru's version of the Toyota C-HR+, a compact electric crossover on sale in the US from early 2026 with front-drive and 338 hp all-wheel-drive versions; on sale in Australia from May 2026.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: 74.7 kWh pack in the US, 221 hp FWD or 338 hp AWD, 150 kW DC charging, NACS port.

models.name: Getaway
models.description: Three-row electric SUV that is Subaru's version of the fifth-generation Toyota Highlander, to be built in Kentucky for North America; launch timing follows the Highlander, now 2027.

legacy_notes.note: Labelled 2023 Solterra Touring but price $38,495 is the 2025/2026 Premium base price (2023 Touring was $53,220 incl. destination); top speed and the 250 kW charging figure are wrong (Solterra peaks at 100-150 kW). EPA 227 is the 2024-2025 Premium figure (Touring: 222). Mapped to original-generation Touring.
Labelled Premium but price $44,995 is the 2023 Premium price excluding destination; top speed 155 mph and 250 kW DC are wrong. Mapped to original-generation Premium.

Labelled Limited; price $48,495 matches the 2023 Limited excluding destination. Range 228 is the Premium figure (Limited/Touring EPA 222); top speed 155 mph and 250 kW DC wrong. Mapped to original-generation Limited. The Solterra itself is current (facelifted for 2026).
